business_scope.primary_industry_name: Passive Holding of Subsidiary Shares and Corporate Dividends

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (Civil Law sovereign with Anglo-American corporate law heritage)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Panama–United States Trade Promotion Agreement (TPA), Investment Chapter, effective since 31 October 2012
Panama–United Kingdom Bilateral Investment Treaty, signed 1983
European Union–Central America Association Agreement (applied to Panama since 2013)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley No. 23 de 27 de abril de 2015 (AML/CFT framework), as amended by Ley No. 70 de 2019; Decreto Ejecutivo No. 363 de 2015 (regulatory text); Decreto Ejecutivo No. 59 de 16 de marzo de 2020 (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales before the Dirección General de Ingresos, DGI); implementing rules and resolutions of the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF) and the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of valid passport or national identity card of each shareholder, director, officer and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent authority of the state of origin (national police, immigration service or consular office)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where the issuing state is party to the 1961 Apostille Convention; otherwise Panamanian Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney (carta poder) appointing the resident agent and incorporation counsel
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public of the grantor's country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank letter of good standing and financial reference for the funding shareholder, issued by a regulated financial institution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Correspondent or account-holding bank of the shareholder or UBO

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing or certificate of incumbency of the parent entity where the shareholder is a corporate vehicle
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent corporate registry or registered agent of the parent entity's jurisdiction

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley General de Sociedades (General Corporation Law), Law 32 of 26 February 1927, as amended and codified — including provisions on incorporation, charter contents, share capital and share subscription, registered office, resident agent, directors and officers; Law 47 of 2013 (registered shares, abolition of bearer shares); Executive Decree 274 of 1965 (Public Registry filing and fee rules); Law 23 of 2015 and Executive Decree 264 of 2017 (Beneficial Ownership Registry regime).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sección Mercantil (Mercantile Section of the Public Registry of Panama)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución (Public Deed of Incorporation) and its notarized testimonio, inscribed as a registered document in the Mercantile Section of the Public Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement and no escrow deposit obligation. The charter must state an authorized capital of no less than USD 10,000, typically divided into registered par-value shares or shares of no par value. Subscription consideration may be paid in cash, property, or services at such time and terms as the board determines; no bank escrow account is required to be funded at incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: Upon due call, a quorum being present, the Directors adopted: RESOLVED, that the Company's incorporation by Public Deed No. ____, inscribed in the Public Registry of Panama, is ratified. RESOLVED, that the subscription of (10,000) common shares is approved, share certificates issued, and subscription proceeds applied. RESOLVED, that the registered office and resident agent are confirmed at [address], Panama. RESOLVED, that ________ is appointed President, ________ Secretary, and ________ Treasurer, and the Corporate Seal is adopted. RESOLVED, that the President and Secretary, acting jointly, may open bank accounts, designate signatories, and execute all documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Trámites en Línea and Atención al Usuario (www.registropublico.gob.pa)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a formal name availability search in the Mercantile Section index for the proposed corporate name and two alternatives; verify that the name is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing entity; file the reservation request ('Aviso de Nombre'), pay the prescribed search fee, and obtain the name-reservation confirmation before deed drafting.
required_dossiers: Completed name-search application form
Three proposed corporate names in descending order of preference
Copy of the applicant's passport or valid government-issued ID
Proof of payment of the name-search fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity, resubmit with the next alternative name or file a written differentiation argument; the Registry's refusal may be cured within 30 days by requesting reconsideration with supporting trademark and name-search evidence.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation of Spanish-Language Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública del Circuito de Panamá (Panamanian Notary Public)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct corporate counsel to draft the Escritura Pública de Constitución in Spanish under the Ley General de Sociedades; include all statutory clauses: corporate name, general purpose clause authorizing passive holding of subsidiary shares and collection of dividends, duration of the company, registered office, resident agent appointment, authorized capital and share classes, subscription schedule, and appointment of the initial directors and officers; review the draft against registry admissibility criteria before notarization.
required_dossiers: Passport copies of the incorporators and first directors
Proof of the reserved corporate name
Shareholding structure and proposed subscription schedule
Resident agent acceptance letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar subsequently detects a drafting defect, cure by preparing a rectification or amendment deed before the same notary and re-filing with the Public Registry; no fee waiver for corrective filings shall be assumed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of the Public Deed of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública del Circuito de Panamá
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The incorporators or their lawfully appointed attorney-in-fact must appear personally before the Notary; the Notary verifies identity and legal capacity, authenticates signatures, and issues the notarized testimonio (certified copy) for inscription; pay the notarial fee and applicable Panamanian stamp duties at this stage.
required_dossiers: Final drafts of the Articles of Incorporation in Spanish
Original passports or valid ID cards of all signatory incorporators
Notarized power of attorney if signing through a proxy
Receipts for applicable notarial and stamp fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Notary observes signature or identity discrepancies, have the corrected signature pages marked and initialed by the Notary; if the proxy power is defective, re-execute the deed after curing the power of attorney.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing and Inscription with the Mercantile Section of the Public Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sección Mercantil
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the original notarized testimonio of the Public Deed together with the completed registry filing form and proof of payment of official fees; submit through the Registry's counters or the official queue; the Registrar performs the qualification review and, upon compliance, inscribes the corporation in the Mercantile Section assigning the electronic folio; expedited inscription may be requested where faster availability is required.
required_dossiers: Original notarized testimonio of the Public Deed of Incorporation
Photocopy of the deed for the filing officer's reference copy
Completed Public Registry filing form and cover sheet
Proof of payment of official Registry fees and stamp duties
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a 'nota de defecto' (defect note), the defect must be cured within 30 calendar days by filing a corrective rectification deed or written clarification; if the cure term lapses, re-file with new fees and any applicable surcharge.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certified Corporate Extract and Legal Existence Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Oficina de Certificaciones
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Request against the assigned folio the certified corporate extract and the Certificado de Personería Jurídica (certificate of legal existence); this document evidences the incorporation, corporate name, capital, registered office, resident agent, and current officers and is the foundational document for banking onboarding and tax registration.
required_dossiers: Corporate folio and inscription reference number
Completed certificate request form
Proof of payment of the certification fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certified extract contains inconsistent or outdated data, request an official correction note or file a rectification certificate; after correction, re-request the certificate with a new application and fee payment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organization Meeting, Share Subscription and Appointment of Officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Internal corporate act — recorded by the Resident Agent and Corporate Counsel; no public filing required unless the charter is amended
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the statutory organizational meeting or execute the written unanimous consent of the incorporators; adopt the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution; approve the share subscription and allocation schedule; issue registered share certificates only (bearer shares are prohibited under Law 47 of 2013); record the minutes in the corporate minute book and register the issued shares in the share ledger.
required_dossiers: Pro-Forma First Board Resolution
Share subscription and allocation schedule
Issued share certificates in registered form
Corporate minute book and share register
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the meeting lacks a quorum, convene an adjourned meeting within 30 days; if share certificates are disputed or defective, cancel and reissue certificates pursuant to a corrective board resolution and ledger annotation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Resident Agent Engagement and Registered Office Confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá (for resident agent appointment or change filings); governed by the General Corporation Law
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute a resident agent engagement agreement with a Panamanian licensed attorney or a corporation authorized to act as resident agent; confirm the registered office address (domicilio) in the Republic of Panama; file the resident agent's acceptance or change at the Public Registry where required; the agent must maintain availability to receive process service and official communications.
required_dossiers: Signed resident agent engagement agreement
Written acceptance letter from the resident agent
Statement of the registered office physical address
Public Registry filing form for agent appointment or change (if any)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry rejects an agent change, correct the filing form and supporting documents; until the change is properly recorded, the outgoing resident agent remains legally responsible for service of process.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration — RUC and Aviso de Operación
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas de Panamá
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the corporation with the DGI using Formulario 6909 (Aviso de Operación / Taxpayer Registration); obtain the Registro Único de Contribuyentes (RUC) number; confirm the territorial-scope classification for Panamanian-source income; submit the initial taxpayer file and, where required, open the electronic taxpayer mailbox to receive fiscal notifications; file any required nil or informational tax declarations after registration.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the inscribed Public Deed of Incorporation
Certificado de Personería Jurídica issued by the Public Registry
Passport or ID of directors and legal representative
Registered office certification and resident agent confirmation
Completed Formulario 6909
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DGI queries the filing, provide the requested corporate documents through the DGI service window or online portal, pay any applicable surcharge for late or deficient filings, and resubmit the form for expedited processing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales — administered by the Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the beneficial ownership declaration through the DGI portal or via the company's authorized legal counsel; identify every ultimate natural-person shareholder with full name, identification document, nationality, tax residence, and percentage of capital, voting rights, or control; comply with Law 23 of 2015 and its implementing regulations; undertake to update the registry within 30 days of any ownership change.
required_dossiers: RUC certificate issued by the DGI
Certified corporate extract and personería jurídica
Passport or national ID and tax-residence documentation for each ultimate beneficial owner
Completed beneficial ownership declaration form
Power of attorney if the filing is submitted by counsel
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Non-filing or deficient filing is subject to monetary fines; cure by promptly submitting a rectified declaration through the DGI portal and paying the applicable late-filing fee.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — no industrial license from the Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI), Dirección General de Industrias, is required for a pure equity-holding SPV under ISIC 6420 with no manufacturing or commercial operation in Panama.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable — no operating permit, municipal commercial patent, or industrial license is mandated for the passive holding of subsidiary shares and collection of corporate dividends.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) — República de Panamá
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — the SPV has no physical plant, no construction, no industrial process, and no discharge or emission source; no environmental impact assessment, environmental registration, or MiAMBIENTE permit is required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable — no point-source wastewater discharge, air emissions, or hazardous waste generation. If the company later opens a physical administrative office, compliance with municipal sanitary permits and local wastewater and solid-waste handling ordinances will be required.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable at formation — the company maintains no employees and no physical workplace; its registered office is the licensed office of the resident agent, which already holds the necessary fire-safety and occupational clearances. If a brick-and-mortar office is subsequently occupied, a fire-safety inspection certification from the Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá, municipal 'Aviso de Operación', and workplace health-clearance approvals will be required.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF), Republic of Panama; online tax portal: Sistema Integrado de Tributación (SIT) at sit.mef.gob.pa.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign beneficial owner must instruct a licensed Panamanian resident agent to apply to the DGI for issuance of the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyentes), which is the sole national tax identification number. The resident agent files the official RUC application through SIT or at a DGI office, attaching: notarized and Public Registry-inscribed articles of incorporation and bylaws; a legal certificate from the Public Registry showing the S.A. is in good standing; the resident agent's acceptance and proof of appointment; a notarized board resolution identifying the local representative and ultimate beneficial owners; an executed municipal Aviso de Operación for the registered office address; and proof of the registered address. Upon review, the DGI issues the RUC certificate, which simultaneously enrols the company for corporate income tax and ITBMS (VAT) purposes. There is no minimum capital requirement and no residency requirement for shareholders.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Panama does not provide check-the-box or any other entity-classification election for a Sociedad Anónima; an S.A. is a per-se corporation. No hybrid mismatch or pass-through elections are available under Panamanian law. A pure equity-holding SPV may elect to maintain a particular fiscal year upon registration, though this does not alter its territorial-source classification. Special fiscal regime elections (e.g., legal stability contracts or SEM headquarters regime) are not relevant to a passive holding SPV and do not create pass-through treatment.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios (ITBMS) — Panama's value added tax system.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No numeric geographic threshold for ordinary taxable activities. Any person habitually performing taxable transfers of goods or services in Panama is required to register for ITBMS using the RUC. A simplified small-taxpayer regime exists for annual gross turnover below PAB 300,000, but this does not exempt the entity from registration if it has Panama-source commercial activities. A foreign pure-equity holding SPV with no Panamanian-source operational activities generally has no ITBMS registration nexus.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Panama mandates electronic invoicing through the SIF-E (Sistema de Facturación Electrónica), fully integrated with the SIT portal. All invoices and equivalent documents must be digitally signed and transmitted in near real time to the DGI for fiscal validation and stamping; each accepted invoice receives a unique DGI authorization code and QR matrix. The issuance of an invoice without prior DGI clearance, or outside the SIF-E channel, is legally defective and may trigger fines, establishment closure, and disallowance of input VAT credits.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A 0% ITBMS rate applies to: (i) exports of tangible movable goods physically departing Panama under a valid customs export declaration; (ii) services rendered from Panama to a non-resident recipient whose economic use and enjoyment occurs wholly abroad, provided the services are not directly tied to Panamanian real estate or movable goods present in Panama; and (iii) other transactions expressly zero-rated by the ITBMS Law. For a pure equity-holding SPV, foreign-source dividends and gains from transfers of foreign subsidiary shares are not 'exports' for ITBMS purposes and remain outside Panamanian territorial income tax. To substantiate zero-rating, the taxpayer must retain the full customs, freight, contract, and foreign payment documentation proving the overseas destination and actual flow of funds from abroad. Panama imposes no statutory FX repatriation deadline; nevertheless, the bank credit record evidencing settlement from abroad is the primary audit evidence.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración Única Aduanera, DUA), accepted and stamped by the Autoridad Nacional de Aduanas
Bill of Lading / Airway Bill / loading manifest showing physical departure from Panamanian customs territory
Commercial invoice issued on the company's letterhead
Foreign inward remittance certificate or SWIFT MT103 confirming receipt of settlement from abroad
Export service contract defining the foreign recipient, scope of services, and place of economic use (for services)
Packing list and certificate of origin (for goods)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The DGI may comprehensively audit zero-rated export claims, verifying customs departure, the existence of the foreign recipient, the place of use, and the wired payment. If a purported export is recharacterised as a domestic taxable transaction, the DGI will assess the 7% ITBMS due retroactively, plus monthly surcharges (1% per month or equivalent calibration), and apply penalties ranging from 50% to 200% of the omitted tax in cases of negligence or fraud. Fraudulent invoice issuance attracts separate civil fines, possible economic offence sanctions, and criminal liability under Panama's fiscal enforcement rules. The DGI may also claw back any input VAT credit claimed on export-related procurement where zero-rating is unwarranted, together with interest and full restoration of the credit.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The Republic of Panama does not maintain a central bank. The supervising authority for banking, treasury, and financial-system stability is the Superintendency of Banks of the Republic of Panama (Superintendencia de Bancos de la República de Panamá). The Banco Nacional de Panamá acts solely as the fiscal and clearing agent of the State, and the Panamanian Balboa (PAB) is a nominal unit circulating at par with the US dollar, which serves as legal tender.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panama is a fully dollarized, open-market economy. There are no exchange controls, no capital or current account segmentation, no administrative approvals for inbound or outbound transfers, and no restrictions on dividend remittances, profit repatriation, or proceeds of liquidation. Convertibility is effectively absolute for all lawful transactions in any currency; the only practical frictions are bank-level AML/KYC due diligence, the availability of correspondent banking relationships, and the willingness of counterparties to transact with a Panamanian intermediate holdco. The territorial tax system and the absence of a national currency eliminate any sovereign FX conversion bottleneck.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None exist. Panama imposes no statutory timeline for repatriation, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no surrender obligation for export or any other foreign receipts. Because the US dollar is the domestic legal tender, all proceeds retained by a Panamanian Sociedad Anónima remain freely disposable in USD or any foreign currency. The only applicable compliance duties are the general anti-money-laundering record-keeping and suspicious-transaction reporting obligations under Law 23 of 2015, administered by the Financial Analysis Unit (Unidad de Análisis Financiero).

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account and Capital Escrow Account
Operational Account with Treasury Sweep Capability
Operational Account and Corporate Escrow Account
Operational Account and Capital Escrow Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium-Low as the sole treasury rail and Medium-High as a supplementary collection channel. Panamanian law, including the fintech licensing regime introduced by Law 13 of 2018 and supervised by the Superintendency of Banks, does not prohibit a Panamanian S.A. from maintaining accounts with foreign-regulated payment institutions. However, foreign digital EMIs and neobanks generally impose jurisdictional restrictions, frequently decline or limit services to Panamanian corporate entities because Panama has historically been treated as a higher-risk financial center, and cannot access the local ACH-Panamá clearing rail. An offshore EMI account should therefore be confined to USD collections or disbursements in supported corridors, with automatic sweeps via SWIFT MT103 into a tier-1 Panamanian bank account. It must not be relied upon for capital escrow, dividend distributions, or trade settlement infrastructure.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For tier-1 licensed commercial banks, the ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) and the authorized signatories of the S.A. are generally expected to undergo a live identity interview. Following the post-pandemic regulatory relaxation and risk-based criteria, secure videoconference interviews are now accepted by several international-facing banks, including Towerbank International and Banistmo, especially where all corporate documents are apostilled and a regulated bank reference letter is provided. Most local banks require one original certified copy of the corporate opening resolution, the registered shareholders ledger, the UBO declaration, and legalized due-diligence forms; the Panamanian resident agent or counsel may serve as the physical anchor. Remote opening is therefore feasible on a bank-specific basis but is not a statutory right, and the compliance decision ultimately rests with each licensed bank's Risk Management Committee.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owners resident in, or connected with, jurisdictions under FATF enhanced monitoring, sanctions lists, or perceived higher-risk financial centers.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled passports of all UBOs, certified tax residence certificates, a sworn declaration of source of wealth and source of funds, three years of bank reference letters from regulated financial institutions, an independent AML opinion from Panamanian counsel confirming full identification of the natural-person ownership chain, and evidence of the commercial rationale for interposing the Panamanian holdco.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque ownership structure, including historic bearer shares, nominee directors without disclosed principals, or multi-layered trust arrangements.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the Escritura Pública incorporating a Bearer Share Elimination Protocol, the registered shareholders ledger listing every registered owner of issued shares, a simplified corporate organization chart terminating in natural persons, the trust deed excerpts identifying settlors and protectors if applicable, the notarized UBO declaration under Law 23 of 2015, and a comfort letter from the corporate agent or fiduciary confirming the absence of undisclosed principals.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-speed capital flows, namely a newly incorporated S.A. receiving a large third-party wire transfer without an established bank trail or credible historical financial statements.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized capital subscription minutes and board resolution ordering receipt of the contribution, signed and dated share certificates, the underlying subscription or acquisition agreement, the investor's source-of-funds evidence such as audited financial statements and bank statements covering the prior six months, escrow or closing statements where applicable, and a legal opinion concluding that the entity is purely passive and balance-sheet driven.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Broader corporate purposes in the articles potentially touching regulated activities, such as crypto-asset intermediation, trust services, funds administration, or money transmission, when mismatched with ISIC 6420 pure equity holding.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Amended articles of incorporation limiting the corporate purpose strictly to the acquisition and holding of equity participations, a legal opinion confirming that the entity and its intended transactions are exempt from the licensing requirements of the Superintendency of Banks and the Superintendency of the Securities Market, an undertaking letter from the board confirming avoidance of regulated activities, and the annual Aviso de Operación demonstrating passive holding operations.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity injections must be routed as SWIFT MT103 or MT202 USD wire transfers from the investing entity into a Panamanian licensed bank account, with a corresponding New York correspondent clearing via CHIPS or Fedwire. Panamanian banks do not maintain a national FX purpose-code registry; instead, the remitter must complete the bank's economic-activity and purpose declaration and include in MT103 Field 70 an explicit remittance description such as SUSCRIPCION DE CAPITAL O APORTE DE CAPITAL SOCIAL together with the corporate RUC and the unique account number. The receiving bank will verify the credit against the corporate resolution, the share subscription minutes, and the UBO file, and will request a sworn source-of-funds declaration for amounts exceeding its internal reporting threshold. Funds arrive in USD without conversion, surrender, or regulatory pre-approval, and are immediately available in the S.A.'s operational or escrow sub-account.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound treasury settlements, including dividend distributions, intercompany loan repayments, and acquisitions of subsidiaries, are executed as SWIFT MT103 transfers settling through the local ACH-Panamá system for domestic USD items and through New York CHIPS or Fedwire correspondents for international transfers. Panama's licensed banks issue documentary commercial letters of credit under UCP 600 and standby letters of credit under ISP98 for trade-related disbursements, with sight drafts financed against the USD credit line of the S.A. No foreign-exchange license or central-bank approval is required because the domestic legal tender is the US dollar; where the recipient requires EUR, GBP, JPY, or a Latin American currency, the SPV may purchase the foreign currency spot from the serviced bank at the prevailing market rate, with settlement conducted through the correspondent network of the Panamanian institution. All disbursements must be matched against board-authorized payment records and the AML file of each beneficiary to preserve the compliance trail.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: OTC deliverable foreign exchange forwards in USD/EUR, USD/GBP, and USD/JPY executed under an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement with a Panamanian licensed bank or a regulated international dealer.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in USD/BRL, USD/COP, and USD/MXN with international counterparties, used where the local Latin American currency market imposes convertibility or settlement restrictions.

Cross-currency swaps and FX swaps converting USD into EUR or into select Latin American currencies for medium-term parent-funding or acquisition liabilities, subject to bilateral credit approval and, where required, a Credit Support Annex.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Público de Panamá (Public Registry of Panama)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually from 1 January to 31 March; no statutory extension. The tax is payable for the entire calendar year regardless of inactivity or absence of income.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment penalty of USD 50 for the first month or fraction, plus USD 10 per additional month, capped at USD 100. Under Ley 2 de 2015, three consecutive years of non-payment trigger administrative dissolution (strike-off); reinstatement costs USD 250 plus all arrears and penalties.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Income Tax Return (Declaración Jurada de Rentas, Formulario 200)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within the third month after the close of the declared fiscal year; for the standard calendar-year S.A., no later than 31 March. A nil or zero return is mandatory for a tax-dormant pure holding SPV.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Statutory late-filing and omission fines under the Código Fiscal, default interest on any assessed tax, suspension of the tax solvency certificate (paz y salvo), and practical restriction of Public Registry and banking transactions until the return is filed.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Sworn Declaration (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales, RUB)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Beneficial Ownership Registry (RUB)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Initial declaration within 30 days of Public Registry inscription; annual confirmation validated in the first-quarter window ending 31 March; any share transfer or change of control must be updated within 30 days of the event.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines under Law 23 de 2015 for non-filing or false declarations; a pending RUB declaration blocks issuance of clean good-standing certificates, prevents renewal of the resident agent mandate, and restricts regulated-bank services.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Resident Agent and Registered Office Continuity
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Panama resident agent; recorded with the Registro Público de Panamá
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Continuous statutory condition precedent. Appointment, resignation, or replacement of the resident agent must be filed with the Public Registry within 30 days of the change; the annual retainer renews in coordination with the franchise-tax season.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Absence of a resident agent constitutes a registrable breach of Law 32 de 1927; the company is barred from obtaining certificates, amending its articles, or transferring shares, and chronic non-compliance exposes the entity to ex officio dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Director and Officer Election Declaration (Declaración de Directores y Oficiales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 10 days of each election of directors or appointment of the president, treasurer, and secretary under Law 32 de 1927; applicable to board rotations resulting from the annual shareholders' meeting or anniversary of incorporation.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unrecorded elections are ineffective against third parties; late presentation attracts Public Registry administrative delay fees and undermines the evidentiary value of the corporate minutes.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No general statutory audit applies to a private, non-licensed Panamanian S.A. An independent audit becomes compulsory when the entity: (i) is licensed or supervised by the banking, securities, insurance, or gaming regulators; (ii) is classified by the DGI as a major taxpayer (Gran Contribuyente) or is specifically required to present audited financial statements; or (iii) is obligated under its by-laws, shareholder agreement, or financing covenants. A passive equity holding SPV in this scope may file on the basis of management accounts unless one of the triggering conditions is met.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted in Panama; the Colegio de Contadores Públicos Autorizados de Panamá (CCPAP) has designated IFRS as the national accounting framework, with IFRS for SMEs permitted for non-public-interest entities. Statutory accounting records must be maintained in Spanish.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under Law 23 de 2015 and Executive Decree No. 20 of 2021, every S.A. must file a sworn declaration identifying all ultimate beneficial natural persons. The initial declaration is due within 30 days of inscription; the annual declaration must be confirmed by 31 March in the same window as the franchise tax; any change of ownership, including intra-group share transfers, is reportable to the DGI within 30 days. The resident agent retains the official declaration certificate on file, and the DGI reconciles the RUB database with Public Registry records.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members / Share Ledger (Registro de Acciones)
Minute Book (Libro de Actas) for shareholders' and board meetings
Statutory accounting ledgers and journals (Libros de Contabilidad)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400-1,200 per annum (market range for a licensed Panama resident agent retainer including registered office services for an inactive or holding entity, plus any separately assessed DGI RUB administration fees)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500-6,000 per engagement (market estimate for an independent certified audit of a single-entity passive holding S.A. with minimal transactions)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial regime: foreign-source dividend and capital gain income of the pure equity holding SPV is exempt from Panamanian ISR; no CFC attribution applies to undistributed foreign subsidiary earnings; exempt income is segregated and allocable expenses are non-deductible; the 25% headline applies only to Panama-source net taxable income above USD 1.5 million, with 10% below USD 50,000 and 15% from USD 50,001 to USD 1.5 million; the 2025 statutory reform phases the headline rate to 20% by 2029.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 141 (Declaración Anual de Renta de Personas Jurídicas) filed electronically through the DGI e-Tax 2.0 portal (Agencia Virtual) at etax.dgi.gob.pa.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due no later than 31 March following the fiscal year-end for calendar-year taxpayers; for off-calendar fiscal years, the last day of the third month after the fiscal year close; no blanket extension exists, only DGI-granted individual deferrals.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income (Ingresos Brutos): all gross receipts before deductions, including Panama-source dividends, interest, and any local service revenue.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include only Panamanian-source receipts; attach a schedule detailing exempt foreign-source dividends from wholly owned non-resident subsidiaries.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exempt income: foreign-source dividends, capital gains from foreign share disposals, and other territorial-system exclusions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Document the exemption with board minutes, subsidiary tax residency certificates, and wire evidence; unsupported exclusions trigger recharacterization risk.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductions: only expenses directly allocable to Panama-source gross income; expenses allocable to exempt foreign-source income are disallowed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: SPVs typically show minimal deductions; any management fees must be supported by transfer-pricing-compliant invoices.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income (Renta Neta Gravable) after applying the territorial allocation apportionment formula.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute separately from exempt foreign income; avoid netting exempt dividend losses against taxable Panama-source profits.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax payable at the applicable tier rate (10%, 15%, or 25%) on net taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a pure equity SPV with no Panama-source activity, amount normally zero; maintain a formal zero-declaration record.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Advance payments, withholding tax credits, and balance due or refund.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile monthly Form 143 prepayments against the annual liability; refunds require certified audit statements.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a fine of 5% of the tax due, 1% monthly default interest, and a 10% late-payment surcharge; non-filing of a zero-declaration carries administrative fines up to USD 10,000, suspension of good standing, and tax liens over SPV assets.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 143 (Declaración Mensual de Anticipo) submitted via e-Tax 2.0.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within the first 10 days of the month following the taxable month; mandatory where the average net taxable income of the preceding two fiscal years exceeded USD 250,000.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registro Único de Contribuyente identifier of the S.A.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Obtain the RUC through the resident registered agent before any return is filed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Calendar month to which the advance corresponds.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Zero-filing is accepted where no Panama-source income is accrued.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computed installment base and applicable percentage set by DGI tables.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the statutory rates; payments are creditable against final Form 141 liability.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax due for the month after prior credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Wire payments from the Panama bank account; foreign third-party payments raise AML red flags.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Omitting Form 143 triggers 1% monthly default interest, a 10% surcharge on the unpaid amount, and loss of deduction rights for the unpaid advance.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 150 (Declaración Informativa de Precios de Transferencia) and the annual ESR substance declaration, both filed via e-Tax 2.0.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: TP informative return due within 6 months after fiscal year-end; ESR declaration due within 8 months after fiscal year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate intercompany loans, shareholder advances, dividend waivers, and administrative service charges.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For pure holding SPVs, report subscription and capital contribution flows; zero reporting is acceptable only if truly no transactions occurred.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Arm's-length methodology applied to each controlled transaction category.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Document CUP or Cost Plus for any service; a dormant SPV should state 'no controlled transaction'.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation of office, employees, assets, and management presence in Panama.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide the lease of the registered office, registered agent engagement letter, and payroll evidence.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file Form 150 or the ESR declaration triggers fines up to USD 100,000, automatic tax adjustment, and disqualification of the SPV from obtaining a tax residency certificate.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Panama has a very limited DTA network (e.g., Mexico, UAE, Barbados, Portugal, Qatar, several not fully in force). To invoke treaty relief, the non-resident parent must obtain a Certificate of Tax Residency (TRC) from its own tax authority, instruct the Panamanian payer before the distribution, and file the DGI-specific relief form together with a sworn economic-beneficiary declaration; the DGI may apply withholding first and issue a refund upon post-payment review. In practice, for a pure equity SPV distributing foreign-source exempt earnings, the Panama dividend WHT is 0% and treaty relief is unnecessary.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties paid to non-residents are subject to 12.5% final Panama WHT; interest paid to non-resident financial institutions is subject to 6% WHT and to 12.5% for other non-resident lenders; applicable DTA rates generally range between 5% and 10%, available only upon TRC submission and pre-payment form registration.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File and sworn TP return (Form 150) trigger where aggregate related-party transactions exceed USD 2,000,000 (Panama Balboa at parity with USD) in a fiscal year; Master File is required for multinational groups with consolidated revenue above USD 85,000,000; CbC reporting applies to groups with consolidated revenue of at least EUR 750,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Panama ESR (Executive Decree 358 of 2021, effective 1 January 2022) applies to pure equity holding SPVs as a covered relevant activity with a reduced substance test: a registered office in Panama, adequate physical premises, a qualified resident director or registered agent, accounting records maintained in Panama, and board-level oversight of subsidiary management; annual ESR declaration must be filed within 8 months of the fiscal year-end; non-compliance triggers fines up to USD 100,000, loss of good standing, and automatic exchange of beneficial ownership information.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately omitting Panama-source income, fabricating deductions, mischaracterizing Panama-source dividends as foreign-source exempt income, or maintaining double books for the SPV.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Surcharge of up to 30% of the omitted tax plus 1% monthly default interest; criminal tax fraud under the Criminal Code is punishable by 2 to 5 years imprisonment and fines of 1 to 3 times the evaded tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil is pierced under the Código Fiscal where returns reflect fraudulent intent; directors and the registered agent become jointly and severally liable for the tax debt, and travel bans and precautionary asset seizures may be imposed pending final assessment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the SPV as a mere mailbox with no Panamanian office, no local accounting records, no registered agent oversight, and no board activity while holding substantial foreign subsidiaries.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ESR fines up to USD 100,000 per instance, deregistration from the Registro Público, cancellation of tax residency certificates, and exclusion from the territorial-exemption regime for foreign-source dividends.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the resident registered agent face professional discipline and monetary fines; directors may be disqualified from serving in Panama and the ultimate beneficial owner loses access to Panama banking and good standing certificates.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the SPV to layer suspicious transfers, accepting unexplained capital injections, executing pass-through payments without business purpose, or dealing with sanctioned persons.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Law 23 of 2015 and Decree Law 2 of 2018, money laundering is punishable by 5 to 10 years imprisonment, fines up to USD 1,000,000, and asset forfeiture.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners are charged individually for laundering; preventive freezing orders, travel bans, and extradition cooperation apply, and the predicate offense expressly includes tax fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file Form 150 or the Local File, structuring intercompany loans and management fees off-market, or executing non-arm's-length dividend waivers to shift economic value.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Mandatory primary adjustment to Panama-source income, secondary recharacterization, 1% monthly default interest, and fines of 5% to 10% of the adjusted amount.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Knowingly certifying false TP documentation exposes directors to joint and several liability for the adjusted tax, penalties, and criminal liability for document forgery.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Submitting a false tax residency certificate or claiming DTA benefits on dividends and interest for a shell SPV with no beneficial ownership and no treaty-resident parent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Denial of treaty benefits, 50% penalty on the under-withheld tax, accrued default interest, and mandatory disclosure to the OECD harmful-tax-practices framework.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Signing officers face up to 5 years imprisonment for forgery; professional deregistration applies to the local counsel or registered agent who facilitated the fraudulent claim.
